code_defects_confirmed: outcome resolution uses latest ticker and a candle window starting before fixedAt
fixed 0.45% target and 35 bps bar for every asset
RANGE return is 0.3-movePct and has no executable meaning
no capital, position, order or equity ledger
flat 24 bps cost model independent of venue and order type
EVS sub-scores are length/regime/anomaly proxies, not expected value
lookback parameter is never used in combination evaluation
15 feature categories have effective dimension about 4
funding direction and normalizedScore have opposite signs
planner prompt contains no prices, volatility, spread or funding
learning loop re-applies all resolved forecasts each cycle (double counting)
out-of-universe forecasts resolve at entry price
next_action: Implement roadmap G0.1-G0.5 (resolution price/window, volatility-scaled barriers, instrument-dependent costs, raw conviction, funding sign). No model work before that.
open_questions: Does k*sigma barrier plus meta-labeling beat fixed 35/45 bps on the same candles?

blockers: no DATABASE_URL, so no replay or backtest was possible in this pass
